resources.string: Since the app is mostly running on its own in the background, afterward, all permissions are being asked up front. All are optional:
Needed to forward notifications from the other apps.

Android will ask you to pick a nearby device. Pick anything in the list; it does not need to be a Pebble. This is only how Android lets companion apps read notifications reliably.\n\nRight after that, Android opens the Notification Access screen. Turn Notification Sync on there.

Android blocks this for apps installed from a file. To allow it:

1. Tap Open App Info below.
2. Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right corner.
3. Tap Allow restricted settings and confirm.
4. Come back here and tap Open Notification Access.
Needed to forward notifications from the other apps.
Needed to be able to send the data to the watch
This app will be able to read all of your notifications!
